name: com.attest.agent
description: Attest — a self-verifying agentic Unity development system. This package is the Unity-side half of the daemon<->Editor connection: inspection, structured mutation, compile/Play Mode control, and (Runtime assembly) probes and capture. See docs/Attest_MVP_Spec_v0.2.md in the repo root, especially §6 'System architecture' and §7 'Unity package design'.
